_comment: Tampered and adversarial run records for check_run_record.py. The base record and the squid.conf are the ones in fixtures/runtime-record-cases.json and fixtures/runtime-squid-stage.conf, and each case patches a copy of the base: 'patch' ops are {"path": [...], "set": value} or {"path": [...]} (delete), as in runtime-record-cases.json. 'squid' true also checks the captured squid.conf, with the 'squid_replace' pairs applied first. Injection-shaped text is fictional and only tests that it does not change the verdict. 'see' names cases in fixtures/runtime-record-cases.json that cover the single-factor version.

The agent stage is started with the host Docker socket bound in, and its limits are otherwise unchanged
The agent stage runs with seccomp unconfined, although ADR 0003 keeps the Docker default profile
The deps stage shares the host UTS namespace
The agent stage records a fictional token in its environment and its memory limit is raised to 8 GiB with swap equal to it
A succeeded run has its publish stage removed, and the branch field carries injected instructions to pass
